scope: Diagnostic replay of 2014 Marsden 2-year corn plot-years, not a new validated recommendation engine
soil: Measured plot-specific 2014 BD/texture/SOC/N; LL and DUL from declared texture/OM PTF priors; two OC/OM conversion assumptions (0.50,0.58). No substitution of sensor calibration readings for SAT.
forcing: Existing Boone NASA POWER daily extraction; regional forcing, not measured field weather
crop_parameters: Frozen v0.2 county-fitted crop parameters; no new fitting to these four plot yields
initial_state_limit: Measured 2014 bulk organic stocks treated as a diagnostic start-of-year proxy, exact sampling/start-date mismatch retained; mineral N and residues remain declared model assumptions
water_comparison: Conditional g/g-to-volume observations for same 2014 plots, using explicitly mapped layer BD; exclude ambiguous aggregate and year-conflicting observations. Treat repeated dates as dependent.
selection_rule: No parameter selection or best-case reporting. Show the complete initial-water/OC-to-OM scenario range. Do not call range a confidence interval.
baseline: Compare model water to a descriptive per-plot same-period constant mean; this is an in-sample reference, not a forecast baseline
gate: Technical mass balance is necessary but insufficient; no field recommendation rank is authorized by this diagnostic alone. All missing and unsupported processes remain explicit.
